newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bourse orders brokers open information.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bourse orders brokers open information.

text.p: The Shanghai stock exchange has ordered all brokerages to publicise each day's five most active stocks and the major traders starting from next Monday, an exchange circular said on Friday.
The circular said all brokerages must display on their trading floors the previous day's five biggest gainers and losers.
If the gaining or losing margins are the same, selections will be made according to their trading volumes, the circular said.
If the volumes are the same, selections will be made on differentiations in turnover, it said.
The brokerages must also make public the five biggest institutional traders in all these shares, the circular said.
The circular said the rule applied to the city's domestic A share market and investment fund market.
The circular did not explain the reason for the move.

Beijing has been tightening control over China's fledgling bourses since late last year, ordering exchanges and brokerages to offer retail investors more information to curb what it called "excessive speculation" on the markets.
